text.title: Cohort Implementation Failure Modes
text.summary: Six antipatterns observed when applying Cohort Implementation. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix. Detector clauses make them mechanically catchable.

antipattern.symptom: Two dashboards disagree on cohort sizes by a few percent every week; the differences concentrate on Sunday and Monday signups.

root-cause.source: BigQuery DATE_TRUNC and Snowflake WEEK_START documentation

antipattern.root-cause: One query truncates to Sunday-start weeks in local time, the other to Monday-start in UTC.
antipattern.fix: Standardise on `DATE_TRUNC(..., WEEK(MONDAY))` over UTC per `r-cohort-key-signup-week-monday-utc`; rebuild both dashboards from the model.

antipattern.symptom: Retention is lower than support tickets and revenue suggest; mobile-heavy cohorts look worst.
antipattern.root-cause: Model joins on `distinct_id` or device id; cross-device users are counted as churned.
antipattern.fix: Join on post-identification `user_id` per `r-stable-user-id-not-anonymous`; resolve identity in staging.

antipattern.symptom: Day-1 retention reads 100 percent; later offsets are implausibly high.
antipattern.root-cause: Denominator taken from the long-format retention model, which contains only retained users.
antipattern.fix: Take the denominator from the users table per `r-denominator-is-full-cohort`.

antipattern.symptom: Every week the newest cohorts show retention collapsing to zero at higher offsets; the chart looks like a cliff.
antipattern.root-cause: Cells whose offset has not elapsed rendered as 0.
antipattern.fix: Null and blank them per `r-incomplete-cells-null-not-zero` using the cutoff-date rule.

antipattern.symptom: Day-60 and day-90 retention decay toward zero for cohorts older than a few weeks, while day-7 looks normal.
antipattern.root-cause: Incremental filter looks back 30 days; late events for older cohorts never land.
antipattern.fix: Set the lookback to at least the largest offset per `r-incremental-key-partition-and-lookback`; run a one-off full refresh.

antipattern.symptom: Retention curve shows a step change on a deploy date; product shipped nothing that week.

root-cause.source: templates/schema.yml (change the retention metric only after backfilling)

antipattern.root-cause: `event_type` filter edited from `login` to another event without a full backfill.
antipattern.fix: Treat as a new version with backfill per `r-retention-event-defined-once`; update `settings.retention_event`.
